newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bull expects main holders to raise stake.
newsitem.headline: Bull expects main holders to raise stake.

text.p: Cie des Machines Bull said it expected its main shareholders Motorola, NEC and France Telecom to apply for buying shares from the state and raise their stakes to some 20 percent.

"We are convinced that our main shareholders will want to increase their stakes and will apply for the shares to be sold by the government. Because of their continued support for the company we expect the Privatisation Commission to give the current large shareholders priority," a Bull spokesman said, adding the move could increase the stakes of either of the three companies to about 20 percent from 17 percent now.
Precise details depend on the exact size of a capital increase and the issue price, to be determined in the next few weeks.
The French government on Tuesday evening said it would sell at least another five percent of shares in Bull in a private placement.
Interested parties have to submit bids for a block of at least 1.4 million shares in Bull, or one percent of the capital.

The operation will cut the state's direct stake to about 30 percent from 36 percent and the indirect stake -- which includes shares held by state-owned telecoms operator France Telecom -- to below 50 percent.
